embedders.description: A list of embedding models available for use by AI Semantic Cache endpoints. Each object defines an embedder configuration.

model_path.title: Model Path
model_path.description: The path to the model files

name.title: Embedder Name
name.description: A unique name that identifies this embedder configuration. This name is referenced by the `ai/semantic-cache` endpoint configuration.

vector_dimension.title: Vector Dimension
vector_dimension.description: The number of dimensions in the vector produced by the embedding model.
